MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 3, 2025
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  11:00 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Stewart called the meeting t0 order at 11: 00 am.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Doug Stewart; Mayor Pro Tem Marianne Riggins (remote
  participation); and Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Bruce Silverstein and Steve Uhring.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Colonel Eric Swenson led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Deputy City Clerk Munoz reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  January 31, 2025.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Councilmember Silverstein moved, and Councilmember Uhring seconded a motion
  to approve the agenda. The motion carried unanimously.

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION

  Mayor Stewart opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: None.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

  At 11:04 a.m., the Council recessed to Closed Session to discuss the following items listed
  on the Closed Session agenda:

Conference with Legal Counsel — Anticipated Litigation

  1.  Initiation of litigation pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision (d) of Government
  Code section 54956.9
  Number of potential cases: (2)
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of February 3, 2025
  Page 2 of 3

Personnel Matters pursuant to Government Code Section 54957:

  1.  Public Employee Performance Evaluation
  Title: City Manager

Conference with Labor Negotiator mlrsuant to Government Code Section 54957.6:

  l.  City representative: Interim City Attorney Trevor Rusin
  Unrepresented employee: City Manager Steve McClary

The Council reconvened at 12:30 pm. with all Councilmembers present.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  Interim City Attorney Rusin reported that the meeting convened at 11:00 a.m., after which
  time the City Council recessed to a Closed Session pursuant to Government Code Section
  54956.9, 54957, and 54957.6, with all Councilmembers present. He stated the Council
  discussed the items on the Closed Session agenda and took no reportable action.

ITEM l  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Palisades Fire Phase 1 Household Hazardous Materials Removal
  Recommended Action: Receive and file an update from the Environmental
  Protection Agency (EPA) and Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA)
  on debris removal operations.

  Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) representative  and  Michael
  Montogomery presented a Power Point presentation.

  Mayor Stewart opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Marni Kamins, Dr. Jeremy Fink, Carolyn Day, Valerie Sklarevsky, Andy
  Lyon, Marisa Coughlan, Luca Iacovoni, Jefferson Wagner, Sephanie Martin,
  Pamela Conley Ulich, Scott Ditrich, Linda Rivera, Chad White, Bobby la Bonga,
  Michael Lynn, Paula Login, Madelyn Glickfled, Jo Drummond, Susan Emereling,
  Skylar Peak, Julie Howell, Ryan Embree, Melina Watts, Jacqueline Ayer, Barbara
  Bruderlin, and Dave Cockrell

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Stewart returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item.
   Malibu City Council

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Stewart adjourned the meeting at 3:21 pm.

  Approved and adopted by the City Council of the
  City of Malibu on April 28, 2025.
